ambient: You are advanced by one layer.
The mechanism completes a cycle and immediately begins another.
For a moment you are two layers at once, and it is not comfortable.
description: Everything that exists is stacked in flat layers and you are between two of them, being slid. There is a mechanism doing this. It has no opinion. It has been running the whole time and you have only just been included.
name: The Stack

looks: Flat, and stacked, and every one of them is a whole world seen edge-on.
You slide between two. Neither notices.
One of them is the room you took the drug in. It is very thin.
objects.name: the layers

looks: Doing its job. It has always been doing its job.
You can hear it and the sound is a colour.
objects.name: the mechanism

weather: Each layer has its own weather and you pass through all of them and feel none.
